GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 451 (31 Oct 46) CPC/FP
(SCAPIN-1304)
APO 500
31 October 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Custody of Looted Automobiles.
1. Reference is made to Memorandum for the Imperial Japanese Government, AG 451(3 Oct 46)CPC/FP, SCAPIN-1248, 3 October 1946, subject, "Custody and Storage of Looted Automobiles," from General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers.
2. Authorization is granted to exempt from the provisions of reference Memorandum, pending further instructions, the Plymouth automobile, 1941 model, engine number P1279628, body number 41-3197-99, which is now in custody and protective storage at the looted vehicle warehouse, College of Agriculture, Setagaya, Setagaya-ku, Tokyo.
3. The above vehicle will be placed under custody of the Imperial Household which will be responsible for the care and maintenance of the automobile for the duration of such custody.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
JOHN B. COOLEY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
